{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) then drop duplicates on patient_id
data_dedup = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify deduplication
print('After deduplication:')
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {data_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(data_dedup)}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {len(data_dedup) - data_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Filter to treatment arm only
data_treatment = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check number of patients in treatment arm
print(f'Number of patients in treatment arm: {len(data_treatment)}')

# Compute fraction who responded
responded_fraction = data_treatment['responded'].mean()

print(f'Fraction of patients in treatment arm who responded: {responded_fraction}')

# Return the fraction
responded_fraction"}
